model.name: Comprehensive DnD logging (capture every dropped URL scheme)
model.description: The room drop handler must log EVERYTHING about every drop, framed around URL-scheme capture: all DataTransfer.types, every DataTransfer.items entry (kind+type), DataTransfer.files, and getData() for each advertised type (text/uri-list, text/plain, text/html, text/calendar, text/x-vcard, and Apple UTIs) - then EXTRACT and log the URL SCHEME of each dropped item (mailto/webcal/calshow/maps/geo/tel/x-apple-reminder/http(s)/...). Log to BOTH chat AND server so a drop in Tron's test room is diagnosable. When no handler matches, the log must capture enough to diagnose WHICH scheme/payload was dropped - not just file.name+type (today routeUnknown logs only file.name+type, and the handler reads only dt.files + getData(uri-list||plain), so Apple URL-scheme items that are NOT File objects are invisible).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "on apple iPhone and macOS a lot can be dragged and dropped next to files: emails, calendar entries, locations. Add logging so you see when such action fails and create scrum tasks to start to support them."
model.poClarification: PO clarification 2026-06-29: Apple DnD items are URL SCHEMES, not files (mailto:, webcal:, calshow:, maps:, geo:, tel:, x-apple-reminder:). Goal: seamlessly support all URL formats so they open in their original app via Open-in-New-Tab - same pattern as the YouTube handler (R23.2): detect scheme -> meaningful preview -> Open-in-New-Tab launches the native app. Frame requirements around URL-SCHEME ROUTING, not file handling. R25.1 logging must capture WHICH URL schemes Apple sends on drop; future R25.x = per-scheme preview+handler (email/calendar/map/contact/reminder).

model.crossRefNote: R25.x per-scheme handlers follow the R23.2 YouTube pattern (detect scheme -> preview -> Open-in-New-Tab). R25.1 is the diagnostic instrument that precedes them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On every drop, log all DataTransfer.types entries.
Log every DataTransfer.items entry (kind + type), including non-File items.
Log every DataTransfer.files entry (name, type, size).
For each advertised type, log getData(type) - the raw URL/payload (text/uri-list, text/plain, text/html, text/calendar, text/x-vcard, Apple UTIs).
Extract and log the URL SCHEME of each dropped item (mailto, webcal, calshow, maps, geo, tel, x-apple-reminder, http(s), ...) - the routing key.
Log to BOTH chat (client-visible) AND server (persisted) so a drop in Tron's test room is diagnosable after the fact.
When no handler matches the scheme/type, the log captures enough (all types + getData + extracted scheme) to diagnose WHAT was dropped - replacing today's file.name+type-only routeUnknown.
Apple URL-scheme items that are NOT File objects are captured (handler reads beyond dt.files + getData(uri-list||plain)).
